goal: Run the Node/Express API in Docker with docker compose; it works with `npm run dev` on the laptop but crashes on startup inside the container.
symptom:
PrismaClientInitializationError: Prisma Client could not locate the Query Engine for runtime "linux-musl-openssl-3.0.x".

This happened because Prisma Client was generated for "darwin-arm64", but the actual deployment required "linux-musl-openssl-3.0.x".
Add "linux-musl-openssl-3.0.x" to `binaryTargets` in the "schema.prisma" file and run `prisma generate` after saving it:

generator client {
  provider      = "prisma-client-js"
  binaryTargets = ["native", "linux-musl-openssl-3.0.x"]
}

The following locations have been searched:
  /app/node_modules/.prisma/client
  /app/node_modules/@prisma/client
    at Ln (/app/node_modules/@prisma/client/runtime/library.js:111:9)
    at async Object.loadLibrary (/app/node_modules/@prisma/client/runtime/library.js:111:2134)
expected: The api container starts and GET /health returns 200.
actual: The api container exits with code 1 right after `node dist/server.js` starts.
check_description: The api service logs 'listening on :3000' and stays up.

tried.attempt: Deleted node_modules and ran npm ci again on the laptop, then rebuilt the image
Ran `npx prisma generate` on the laptop before docker compose build
tried.result: Same error, still says generated for darwin-arm64

environment: macOS 15 on Apple Silicon (darwin-arm64) for development; Docker image node:20-alpine (Alpine 3.20, musl, OpenSSL 3); Node 20.18; prisma 5.22.0, @prisma/client 5.22.0; PostgreSQL 16 in a second compose service.

files.excerpt:
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
